scenarios.user: Gather process (scheduled station, sido, forecast or station-list request)
scenarios.goal: Collect AirKorea data although the first selected key is at its daily quota
scenarios.prerequisites: AIRKOREA_SECRET_KEYS has three keys; the last one has used its daily quota
steps: Client tries the last key and receives code 22 or HTTP 429
Client logs KEY_QUOTA with key position, code and UTC end time
Client restarts the request with the previous key
Previous key answers 00; rows are validated and stored
scenarios.expected: Fresh rows; the previous key is remembered; the exhausted key costs no call until KST midnight
scenarios.failure: If the previous key also fails, the next key is tried; nothing is written until a key completes every page

scenarios.goal: Stop spending calls when no key has quota left
scenarios.prerequisites: Every configured key has used its daily quota
steps: Request tries each key once and receives quota
Later requests the same KST day
scenarios.expected: QUOTA_EXHAUSTED after one call per key; later requests that day make no HTTP call; after midnight each key is probed again
scenarios.failure: Repeated calls to exhausted keys on the same day would be a defect

scenarios.goal: Keep the #2737 credential behavior when quota and credential failures mix
scenarios.prerequisites: One key exhausted, the others expired or unregistered
steps: Request skips the exhausted key without HTTP
Credential rejections move through the remaining keys
scenarios.expected: QUOTA_EXHAUSTED (some key will recover after midnight); an all-credential list still ends with NO_VALID_KEY
scenarios.failure: Reporting NO_VALID_KEY while a key is only exhausted would mislead the operator

scenarios.prerequisites: The selected key reaches its quota on page 2
steps: Page 1 succeeds with the last key
Request restarts at page 1 with the previous key
scenarios.expected: Complete list from the previous key; no key requests the same page twice
scenarios.failure: Mixing partial pages or retrying the exhausted key would be a defect

scenarios.goal: See which key position is exhausted and until when
scenarios.expected: Key position, code and UTC end time only; no key text
scenarios.failure: Key text in logs is a defect
